verdict.rationale: A secrets and credentials platform could plausibly offer recurring jobs such as scheduled secret rotation, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only automation building blocks: service accounts, CI/CD secret access, the CLI, SDKs and the Connect REST API. These let external schedulers call 1Password, but nothing documents a first-party way to schedule recurring jobs or workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
